transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I came in because I’m just tired all the time. It’s getting to the point where, by midmorning at work... and I'm a claims adjuster, so it's not like I'm doing heavy physical labor... but after just reviewing a few files or walking a junior adjuster through a claim, it already feels like my body and my brain are just running on empty.
Have you noticed any feelings of sadness, loss of interest in things you used to enjoy, or changes in your mood along with the fatigue?

Yeah, I have. Most days, it just feels like there’s a... like a gray film over everything. Even when things are good. Like if my husband is being kind, or we’re all in the kitchen cooking with the family... I can go through the motions of it, but I just don't really feel the enjoyment I used to.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?
Um, no, I haven't really noticed any changes there. My appetite is about the same as it usually is, and my weight has been pretty steady. My clothes still fit the same, so I think that's all normal.
Have you had any trouble sleeping or noticed changes in your sleep patterns lately?
No, not really. I mean, I sleep through the night fine. I usually get about seven or eight hours, so I don't think my sleep has changed. I'm just always tired anyway.
Have you noticed yourself moving more slowly than usual, or perhaps feeling restless or agitated lately?

No, I haven't really noticed that. I don't feel restless or agitated, and I don't think I'm moving any slower than normal. I mean, I'm definitely tired, like I mentioned, but my actual movements and all that seem pretty much the same as always.
Do you feel down or low most of the day, nearly every day, even if it's just a general sense of feeling burdened or empty?

Yes, I do. Most days it just feels like there’s a... a gray film over everything. Even when my husband is being kind, or we’re cooking together with the family, I just go through the motions. I don't really feel the enjoyment I used to. It's just kind of flat.
How long have you been feeling this way — with the fatigue, the lack of enjoyment, and the low mood?

It's been a long time. I'd say... about three years and three months, maybe a little more. It started right around the time I got moved into a higher-responsibility role at work. I had to start mentoring the other claims adjusters and overseeing all the new workflow systems we were putting in place. That's when I really started noticing it.
Have you had days when you felt unusually guilty, felt like you were a burden, or had trouble concentrating or making decisions, even on small things?

No, I can't say that I have. I don't really feel guilty or like a burden to my family or anything like that. And as for concentrating... no, that's been fine. I have to make a lot of decisions all day at work, reviewing claims and all, so I haven't noticed any trouble with my focus or making choices.
Have you ever had days where you felt so low that you thought about hurting yourself or wished you were dead?

No, I haven't. I've never felt like I wanted to hurt myself or anything like that. It's just that constant low, flat feeling I mentioned, but it hasn't ever gotten to the point where I wished I wasn't here.
Before this current period of low mood and fatigue, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row?

No, not really. I mean... before this started a few years ago, I was generally fine. I never had a time where I felt down or lost interest in things for weeks at a time. It really just began with that work change I mentioned.

You mentioned that this has been going on for about three years and three months. Has there been any period during those three years when you felt like your mood was back to normal for more than a few days at a time?

No, I don't think so. It's just been this... same flat feeling the whole time. I haven't really had any breaks from it where I felt like my old self again, not for more than a day or two anyway. It's just always there.
Have you ever had a period of time when your mood was unusually high, irritable, or you felt like you had more energy than usual, even if it was just for a few days?

No, I haven't. Um, I've never really felt unusually high or had any bursts of extra energy. Honestly, with how tired I usually am, I think I'd definitely notice if I suddenly had a lot of energy out of nowhere. So, no, nothing like that.
Have you noticed that you no longer take pleasure in things that you used to enjoy, even activities that used to make you happy or feel good?

Yes, I have. It's like... most days I feel like there’s a gray film over everything. Even when my husband is being kind, or we’re cooking with the family—things I used to really like—I just kind of go through the motions. I don't really feel the enjoyment I used to feel.
Has your low mood been present most of the time, on most days, for the past two years or more?
Yes, it has. Um, like I mentioned a little bit ago, it's been over three years now. And yeah, it's pretty much every single day, for most of the day. It just stays like that.
